name: 98014 · Carnation, WA
findings: ZIP 98014 (Carnation) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98014 (Carnation) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98014 (Carnation) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
